parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The new description of the host. The description can be up to 500 characters in length.

parameters.name: HostId
parameters.description:
The ID of the host.

> You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to query the ID of the host.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description: The new name of the host. The name can be up to 128 characters.

parameters.name: HostPrivateAddress
parameters.description: The new internal endpoint of the host. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address.

parameters.name: HostPublicAddress
parameters.description: The new public endpoint of the host. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the information about the host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: NetworkDomainId
parameters.description:
The ID of the new network domain to which the host belongs.

> You can call the [ListNetworkDomains](~~2758827~~) operation to query the network domain ID.

parameters.name: OSType
parameters.description:
The new operating system of the host. Valid values:

*   **Linux**
*   **Windows**

parameters.name: PrefKex
parameters.description:
The preferred key exchange algorithm of the host. If you set OSType to Linux, you can modify this parameter. Valid values:

*   **default**
*   **diffie-hellman-group1-sha1**
*   **diffie-hellman-group14-sha1**
*   **diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the information about the host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --host-private-address 193.168.XX.XX --host-public-address 200.1.XX.XX --os-type Linux --host-name TestHost --comment Host_for_test. --network-domain-id 1 --pref-kex default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyHost --region cn-hangzhou --Comment 'Host_for_test.' --PrefKex default --HostPrivateAddress '193.168.XX.XX' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --HostPublicAddress '200.1.XX.XX' --OSType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostId 1 --HostName TestHost --NetworkDomainId 1
